status: Closed — task-scoped admission now preserves the precise staging-required diagnostic; regression and frozen runner publication verified
area: Git work-admission facade / task-scoped commit diagnostics
finding: When a task-scoped commit had a valid file-write ticket but no staged files yet, the work-admission facade passed an empty file set to the ticket gate. The gate rejected the request before the task-scoped commit branch could report ATM_GIT_COMMIT_TASK_SCOPED_STAGING_REQUIRED, masking the actionable staging guidance and producing a misleading refusal shape.
expectedBehavior: A task with an explicit valid file-write ticket must be admitted for diagnostic inspection even when nothing is staged yet. The task-scoped branch must then report the precise staging-required result. Foreign staged files must remain subject to the existing scope and deferral gates, and auto-stage must continue to validate the ticket bundle.
evidenceOrRepro: Reproduced on 2026-09-05 by node --strip-types tests/cli/git-commit-task-scoped-staging.test.ts: the first unstaged task-scoped commit was resolved by runAtmGit as a work-admission result rather than reaching the expected ATM_GIT_COMMIT_TASK_SCOPED_STAGING_REQUIRED path. The fix in packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance.ts uses the declared ticket file scope only when stagedFiles is empty, leaving foreign-only staged cases unchanged. After the fix, the task-scoped staging regression, work-admission coverage gates, git-record-commit regression, npm run typecheck, and git diff --check passed. Frozen runner publication was committed as 9ca1b13946406c3f246df93b144d3e071ecb859b and pushed to origin/main.
containment: The change is limited to the empty-staged-set admission boundary. It does not stage, unstage, defer, restore, or absorb foreign work; the existing ticket scope, temporary-index, and foreign-residue protections remain unchanged. A simultaneous test attempt that shared the fixture directory was discarded and the regression was rerun serially before acceptance.
followUp: Keep the work-admission facade and task-scoped staging regression aligned when future ticket-gate result contracts change. Any broader diagnostic payload improvement should be a separate bounded task; no remaining source defect is claimed by this item.
